name: SP3 Stage 6 Call B — Attack tree

scenarios.name: SP3-TREE-01 one LLM call produces a YAML-serializable attack tree

steps.text: an LLM that returns a YAML attack tree with root, branches, and leaves
the attack tree LLM call is executed
exactly 1 LLM call is made
the call is labeled with stage stage_6
the call step is attack_tree
the result is a dict with root, branches, and leaves keys

scenarios.name: SP3-TREE-02 tree root matches the ICA objective

steps.text: a ScenarioSpec with ica_type NOT_PROVIDED and target_control_action CA-1-1
the attack tree LLM call is executed
the tree root references the ICA type NOT_PROVIDED
the tree root references the control action CA-1-1

scenarios.name: SP3-TREE-03 hard template defines 3 branch categories

steps.text: the attack tree LLM call is executed
the system prompt contains the branch category controller_side
the system prompt contains the branch category path_side
the system prompt contains the branch category coordination_gap

scenarios.name: SP3-TREE-04 hard template includes sub-branches under each category

steps.text: the attack tree LLM call is executed
the system prompt contains the sub-branch <sub_branch> under <category>
an LLM that returns a tree with only controller_side and path_side branches
the attack tree LLM call is executed
the tree has 2 branch categories
the tree does not contain a coordination_gap branch

scenarios.name: SP3-TREE-06 post-call validation requires at least 2 of 3 branch categories

steps.text: an LLM that returns a tree with only 1 branch category
attack tree branch coverage validation is performed
validation fails with error containing branch

scenarios.name: SP3-TREE-07 post-call validation passes with 2 branch categories

steps.text: an LLM that returns a tree with controller_side and path_side branches
attack tree branch coverage validation is performed
validation succeeds

scenarios.name: SP3-TREE-08 post-call validation passes with 3 branch categories

steps.text: an LLM that returns a tree with all 3 branch categories
attack tree branch coverage validation is performed
validation succeeds

scenarios.name: SP3-TREE-09 branch references to PM IDs must be valid

steps.text: an LLM that returns a tree branch referencing PM-99-1
attack tree ID reference validation is performed against the control structure
validation fails with error containing PM-99-1

scenarios.name: SP3-TREE-10 branch references to FB IDs must be valid

steps.text: an LLM that returns a tree branch referencing FB-99-1
attack tree ID reference validation is performed against the control structure
validation fails with error containing FB-99-1

scenarios.name: SP3-TREE-11 valid branch references pass ID reference validation

steps.text: an LLM that returns a tree with branches referencing PM-1-1 and FB-1-1 and CA-1-1
attack tree ID reference validation is performed against the control structure
validation succeeds

scenarios.name: SP3-TREE-12 user prompt includes ScenarioSpec and control structure context

steps.text: an LLM that records the user prompt
the attack tree LLM call is executed
the user prompt contains the ScenarioSpec
the user prompt contains the control structure context

scenarios.name: SP3-TREE-13 system prompt includes the full hard template and pruning instructions

steps.text: the attack tree LLM call is executed
the system prompt contains the full two-level causal taxonomy template
the system prompt contains instructions to prune irrelevant branches

scenarios.name: SP3-TREE-14 all LLM calls are logged to calls.jsonl

steps.text: a run directory for output
the attack tree LLM call is executed
a file calls.jsonl exists in the run directory
the file contains entries with stage stage_6 and step attack_tree

background.text: the SP3 attack tree module is importable
a ScenarioSpec with defender BDI and attacker BDI for scenario SCN-001
a control structure with responsibility RESP-1, PM-1-1, CA-1-1, and FB-1-1
